'''Sulon spaceport''' was a spaceport on [[Sulon/Legends|Sulon]], one of the [[Moon/Legends|moons]] of [[Sullust/Legends|Sullust]].

The spaceport was outside the northern outskirts of [[Barons Hed]]. [[tree/Legends|Trees]] and warehouses lined the western perimeter of the spaceport, and some ran-down buildings with a road running parallel to it. One of its walls was defaced with graffiti.<ref name="SE">''[[Dark Forces: Soldier for the Empire]]''</ref>

[[File:Kyle_Morgan_death.jpg|thumb|left|150px|[[Kyle Katarn]] looking at a holo recording of the Sulon spaceport with the head of [[Morgan Katarn]] on a stick.]]
Sometime in [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]] after the [[Subjugation of Sulon]], the heads of fallen members of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel alliance]] who fell in the [[Battle of the G-Tap]], including [[Morgan Katarn]]'s was put on display on the wall, attracting hundreds of [[Bird/Legends|birds]]. [[A-Cee]] hid in a truck and made his way to the spaceport to leave the planet and deliver his footage to the Alliance.<ref name="SE" />

In [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]] the spaceport still saw regular use. [[Kyle Katarn]] and [[Jan Ors]] [[Mission to Sulon|planed to return]] to Barons Hed, half [[kilometer/Legends|kilometer]] to its west, and spied on the [[Government House (Sulon)|Government House]].<ref name="Dark Forces: Rebel Agent">''[[Dark Forces: Rebel Agent]]''</ref>

Outside the spaceport, the [[Fuel Station]] was the simplest way to leave the moon without a private ship.<ref name="Dark Forces: Soldier for the Empire audio drama">[[Dark Forces: Soldier for the Empire (audio drama)|''Dark Forces: Soldier for the Empire'' audio drama]]</ref>
